rules.penalty: First offense: warning; second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act - notice of tenant rights
rules.requirement: Any Boston landlord ending a tenancy must give you a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources together with the notice to quit or non-renewal, and must also report the notice to the City.
rules.requirement_es: Cualquier arrendador en Boston que termine un arrendamiento debe entregarle un Aviso de Derechos y Recursos del Inquilino junto con el aviso de desalojo o de no renovación, y también debe reportar el aviso a la Ciudad.
rules.coverage_text: All landlords (and foreclosing owners) in Boston planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.quote: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
